policy_chunks.title: Global Monthly Cap
policy_chunks.text: No automated retention package may exceed £150.00 in total value per driver, per calendar month.

policy_chunks.title: Credit Stacking
policy_chunks.text: A driver may not receive more than two immediate credits within the same 24-hour window. If a third issue occurs, the system must escalate to a human City Manager.

policy_chunks.title: Tier Multipliers
policy_chunks.text: Goodwill credits in category Churn are strictly reserved for Gold and Silver tiers only.

policy_chunks.title: Airport Short Fares (SFP)
policy_chunks.text: Applicable only if wait time is greater than 90 minutes and trip distance is less than 3 kilometres. Gold tier cap: £25.00 maximum per instance. Silver and Bronze tier cap: £15.00 maximum per instance. The AI must not use INC-002 (£50) for standard short-fare recovery; it is reserved for documented multi-day systemic failures.

policy_chunks.title: Infeasible Quests
policy_chunks.text: If a driver completes more than 80 percent of a Quest but fails because of documented low demand, and diagnostics confirm fewer than 1.5 offers per hour, a Goodwill Gesture of £20.00 is permitted.

policy_chunks.title: New Starters
policy_chunks.text: For tenure below three months, priority should be given to Commission Shields INC-006 rather than direct credits, to encourage continued app usage.
